_meta.notes: toDus 2.1.2 ships minimally obfuscated Kotlin/Java packages under cu.todus.android.*, cu.todus.proto.ApiProto, and cu.z17.*.

cu.todus.android.BuildConfig.role: Generated build constants (applicationId, versionCode 30102, versionName 2.1.2, buildType pFast)

cu.todus.android.ToDusApp.role: Application entrypoint: DI graph bootstrap, Sentry init, XMPP/Room startup, AliveService management, logout

cu.todus.android.constants.Service.role: Environment URLs (LOCAL/PROD_2/PROD/F5), XMPP domains (im.todus.cu, muclight, ch, status), and REST endpoints

cu.todus.android.backup.AESUtils.role: Backup cipher helper (uses Blowfish/CBC/PKCS5Padding with static IV 'abcdefgh' despite class name)

cu.todus.android.db.ToDusDatabase.role: Primary Room database (toDus.db v11, 15 entities, 9 migrations 2->11)

cu.todus.android.db.CacheDatabase.role: Secondary Room cache database (cache.db v6: Product, WelcomeMessage, BotShortcut)

cu.todus.android.di.RetrofitModule.role: OkHttp/Retrofit DI module, Protobuf/Gson converters, BODY logging, and bundled certPool TLS verification

cu.todus.android.rest.TokenAuthenticator.role: OkHttp Authenticator, Bearer token refresh, User-Agent header injection, and static map URL builder

cu.todus.android.rest.auth.AuthService.role: Retrofit interface for auth.todus.cu Protobuf and link preview endpoints

cu.todus.android.xmpp.ToDusXMPPFactoryCo.role: Smack XMPPTCPConnectionConfiguration builder for im.todus.cu with MD5 resource and compression

cu.todus.android.xmpp.iq.call.GetCredent.role: XMPP IQ query for TURN server credentials (namespace todus:turn:cred)

cu.todus.android.webrtc.SignalingCommand.role: WebRTC call signaling commands (CALL, PICKED, OFFER, ANSWER, ICE, CONFIG, REJECT, END, CHECKING_*)

cu.todus.android.webrtc.ConfigKey.role: WebRTC media toggle keys (CAMERA, MIC, SOUND)

cu.todus.android.webrtc.service.CallServ.role: Foreground phoneCall service managing active WebRTC call notifications

cu.todus.android.alive.AliveService.role: Foreground remoteMessaging keepalive service for XMPP connectivity

cu.todus.android.uiCompose.loading.Loadi.role: LAUNCHER Compose activity observing ToDusApp.appState for initial routing

cu.todus.android.uiCompose.main.MainActi.role: Primary Compose host activity handling chat UI, deep links, and update gates

cu.todus.android.constants.CloudType.role: Media/attachment type constants (TYPE_FILE..TYPE_STATUS_IMAGE) and WorkManager upload/download data keys

cu.todus.android.constants.HeadersChecke.role: Checks whether an s3.todus.cu URL requires authentication headers (exempts official, catalog, videodown, status, stream)

cu.todus.android.exceptions.ToDusExcepti.role: Base application exception carrying an optional retryFunction callback and canRetry flag

cu.todus.android.exceptions.Authenticati.role: ToDusException subclass for authentication failures ('auth error')

cu.todus.android.exceptions.FileWriterEx.role: ToDusException subclass for file write failures ('write file error')

cu.todus.android.exceptions.HTTPExceptio.role: ToDusException data subclass holding HTTP status code and Companion.TYPE

cu.todus.android.exceptions.NotCorrectQr.role: ToDusException subclass thrown on invalid QR code scan (R.string.wrong_qr_code)

cu.todus.android.exceptions.NotCurrentOw.role: ToDusException subclass thrown when account owner initialization does not match current owner (R.string.owner_init_error)

cu.todus.android.exceptions.PhoneAuthExc.role: ToDusException subclass mapping phone auth/reservation/SMS error strings to ERROR_TYPE enum

cu.todus.android.exceptions.ServerError.role: ToDusException subclass carrying message and raw errorBody string

cu.todus.android.exceptions.ServerExcept.role: ToDusException subclass carrying message and numeric error code

cu.todus.android.data.preferences.AliveW.role: Data class tracking Alive welcome message mockupSaved, lastShowed, and actualMax counts

cu.todus.android.data.preferences.AppSta.role: Enum of onboarding and authentication flow states (LOADING..LOGIN_COMPLETED)
Persisted onboarding/auth state (appStep, savedNumber, clientUid, countryCode, lastTimeSmsWaSent)

cu.todus.android.data.preferences.CallQu.role: Persisted WebRTC call sendQuality and receivingQuality preference levels

cu.todus.android.data.preferences.DataPr.role: Persisted media public/auto-download flags, batteryPreference (BALANCED/ECO/FULL_TIME), uploadQuality, and defaultFormat

cu.todus.android.data.preferences.Owner.role: Persisted local account owner profile, credentials (username, password, token, expire), and JID helper getNameWithDomain()

cu.todus.android.data.preferences.Reacti.role: Persisted list of user-selected emoji reactions

cu.todus.android.data.preferences.Roster.role: SharedPreferences helper (roster_version_prefs) tracking last_synced_roster_version and last_local_version

cu.todus.android.data.db.entity.cache.Bo.role: Cache Room entity representing a quick-action shortcut command for a bot

cu.todus.android.data.db.entity.cache.Pr.role: Cache Room entity representing a cached catalog/store product listing

cu.todus.android.data.db.entity.cache.We.role: Cache Room entity representing a cached welcome/onboarding message banner

cu.todus.android.data.db.entity.configs..role: Room entity storing dynamic key/value configuration entries in the heritage table
Tree-structured configuration helper representing a node with parent/children lookup
Key constants for dynamic Config/Heritage feature keys

cu.todus.android.data.db.entity.toDus.At.role: Room entity representing a media/payload attachment bound to a Message with upload/download states and TYPE_* constants

cu.todus.android.data.db.entity.toDus.Ch.role: Room entity storing individual chunks of split long text messages (table message_chunks)

cu.todus.android.data.db.entity.toDus.Co.role: Room entity representing a synchronized address-book contact entry and sync state

cu.todus.android.data.db.entity.toDus.Li.role: Room entity and Gson model representing a linked web/desktop session device

cu.todus.android.data.db.entity.toDus.Ma.role: Room entity tracking XMPP chat marker / delivery-receipt actions on messages

cu.todus.android.data.db.entity.toDus.Me.role: Room entity and Builder representing a chat message with delivery states, MessagePayload, and MessageEntity list

cu.todus.android.data.db.entity.toDus.Re.role: Room entity representing an emoji reaction on a message or status

cu.todus.android.data.db.entity.toDus.Ro.role: Room entity representing a 1-to-1 chat, MUC-light group, channel, or card room with config map accessors
Room entity logging pending or synced local contact roster mutations (ADD/DELETE/UPDATE)

cu.todus.android.data.db.entity.toDus.St.role: Room entity representing an ephemeral user status post (text, image, or video)
Room entity representing an individual sticker within a StickerPack and its CDN URL builder
Room entity representing a downloaded or available sticker pack

cu.todus.android.data.db.entity.toDus.Us.role: Room entity representing a locally cached toDus user profile
Room join entity linking a User to a Room with affiliation role (owner/admin/member/none)
